name: Filter Grid
description: Dark product grid with a sticky filter bar. Choosing a filter animates cards out and the remaining cards slide into their new positions while the grid height adjusts.
contents: Sticky filter bar with toggle buttons and a clear button
Responsive grid of product cards with image, index number, category, name, price and star rating
behavior: Clicking a filter hides non-matching products with scale and fade, and moves the rest with a FLIP style slide
Clicking the active filter or Clear shows all products
editableByProps: Filter names, products, images, prices, ratings
Animation duration, labels and background color

needsCodeEdit.where: text-white classes in the root div and card markup
gridTemplateColumns style on the grid div

fixed: Loads Cormorant Garamond and DM Sans from Google Fonts
Each product must list its filter names in its filters array to match the filters prop
Text uses white tones, so it is meant for dark backgrounds
